biotools.summary: TIDAL is an R Shiny application designed to facilitate growth curve modelling by improving access, analysis, and interpretation of longitudinal data. It provides a user-friendly interface for data wrangling, analysis, visualization, and interpretation of growth curve model data, removing barriers for researchers without specialist statistical backgrounds.
